verdict.rationale: Scribe is API-first, and every input path shown in the UI playground has an API equivalent. Recording maps to the Live WebSocket, upload to synchronous POST /transcribe, and URLs to batch jobs with URI, prefix, or manifest input. Features such as diarization, vocabulary, polishing, language and profanity filtering are exposed as API parameters, and vocabulary assets and the full batch lifecycle have documented REST endpoints and an OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: no explicit parity statement or independent hands-on confirmation, and credential management (expiration, IP allowlist, scopes) is documented only as a console flow with no API equivalent shown.
